steps.action: First-run: create the first Administrator; Skip optional steps on the Welcome step opens Outbound email while email is not configured
steps.expected: Outbound email step with the unset warning, no Set up later, Continue unavailable
steps.actual: The first Administrator was created with the lab's setup token and landed on /welcome. Skip optional steps opened /welcome?step=email with "Set up outbound email to finish instance setup. OpenLaw uses it for invitations, sign-in links, and notifications." The step had no Set up later (buttons ["Save relay","Back","Continue"]) and Continue was disabled.

steps.action: With no saved Organization name, the sign-in pages show OpenLaw
steps.expected: Staff and Portal sign-in pages show OpenLaw and no logo
steps.actual: The organization had no saved name (GET /api/v1/org/branding {"name":"","logo":null}). In a browser with no session: {"/auth/login":{"start":"OpenLaw Legal Portal Sign in Email Password Sign in Help wit","logos":0},"/portal/login":{"start":"OpenLaw Legal Portal Business Portal sign-in Email Password ","logos":0}}.

steps.action: Wizard email steps 1 to 3: SMTP server, Port (starts at 587, follows Connection security until changed), Connection security, Authentication
steps.expected: 587; 465 for TLS; 25 for None; 587 for STARTTLS; a changed port stays; credentials fields only with Username and password
steps.actual: Observed {"initial":"587","securityOptions":["STARTTLS","TLS","None"],"authenticationOptions":["Username and password","None"],"initialAuthentication":"Username and password","tls":"465","none":"25","starttls":"587","changedThenTls":"2525","credentialsWithPassword":[1,1],"credentialsWithNone":[0,0],"senderFields":[1,1]}. The step was reloaded afterwards.

steps.action: Wizard email step 1 negative: SMTP server with an smtp:// prefix or a port is refused
steps.actual: Save relay results: [{"host":"smtp://mailpit","notice":null,"alerts":["One or more request fields are invalid."],"source":"unset"},{"host":"mailpit:1025","notice":null,"alerts":["One or more request fields are invalid."],"source":"unset"}].

steps.action: Wizard email steps 4 to 6 with STARTTLS and Username and password: Save relay stores the credentials encrypted and never returns them; the TLS upgrade must succeed before delivery
steps.expected: Relay saved; no credentials in the page or API; stored value not plain text; Send test email fails; nothing delivered
steps.actual: Save relay showed "Relay saved. The next email this instance sends will use it.". The step read "Outbound email is set in the app. Mail is sent from "DOC-030 Stored" <stored-relay@helix.example>.". GET /api/v1/email-settings returned only {"source":"app","fromAddress":"\"DOC-030 Stored\" <stored-relay@helix.example>"}; neither the page nor the API contained the SMTP username or password. org_settings.smtp_url held a 191-character value without the host, username or password in plain text. Send test email against Mailpit, which offers no STARTTLS, showed "The test email could not be sent. A secure connection could not be established. Check the connection security setting and the relay's TLS certificate." and Mailpit received 0 messages.

steps.action: Wizard email steps 6 and 7: Replace relay opens an empty form; Keep current relay closes it; replace with None and None; Send test email
steps.expected: "Test email sent to" the Administrator; OpenLaw test email with Outbound email works, Sent through and From; Continue available
steps.actual: Check failed: {"subject":"OpenLaw test email","from":"DOC-030 Stored <stored-relay@helix.example>","headline":true,"sentThrough":"mailpit:1025","fromLine":null,"header":{"cid":"openlaw-mark@openlaw","name":"OpenLaw"}} continue disabled false

steps.action: Emails with no organization name and no logo show OpenLaw and the OpenLaw mark in their header
steps.expected: Test email header names OpenLaw with the OpenLaw mark
steps.actual: On the unnamed auth2w instance a test email's header read "OpenLaw" with the inline image openlaw-mark@openlaw.

steps.action: Wizard email step 7: a relay that cannot be reached saves but fails its test; Replace relay again with all details and retest
steps.expected: A saved relay alone does not prove delivery; the corrected relay delivers
steps.actual: An unreachable SMTP server saved with "Relay saved. The next email this instance sends will use it.", but Send test email showed "The test email could not be sent. The relay host could not be found. Check the SMTP server name.". Replace relay, all details entered again, Save relay, and a second test showed "Test email sent to doc030-wiz-admin@helix.example. Check your inbox." and delivered "OpenLaw test email" from stored-relay@helix.example.

steps.action: Wizard email step 8: Clear relay removes the saved relay and stops delivery when there is no environment override; save a valid replacement
steps.expected: Relay cleared; source unset; Continue unavailable; no mail; replacement delivers
steps.actual: Clear relay showed "Relay cleared. This instance can no longer send email." The source became unset and Continue was disabled. A password setup request answered 503 and Mailpit received 0 messages. After a valid replacement was saved, a test message arrived again from stored-relay@helix.example.
